hero.title: The man behind the barrow
hero.subtitle: Forty years of Cambridge tradition, one sausage at a time.

story.title: From a humble barrow to a Cambridge legend

paragraphs.origin: Serving Cambridge's famous hot sausages for over 40 years, our Victorian-style barrow on Fitzroy Street has been a local favourite since 1986. We specialise in classic hot dogs made with the legendary Cambridge sausage, freshly prepared and served with simple, satisfying toppings.
paragraphs.community: What started as a humble street barrow has become a familiar part of the neighbourhood, feeding students, locals, workers, and passers-by alike. Generations have stopped by for a proper hot dog and a friendly chat.
paragraphs.mission: From 1986 to 2026, our mission has stayed the same: great sausages, great service, and a bit of Cambridge tradition on every bun.
paragraphs.grandma: Officially voted the best hot dogs around by our most important critic — my very own grandmother.
